<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>

      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#EEEEEE"/>

    <linearGradient id="purpleGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7A4FF4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#C7667A"/>

    <filter id="softGlow">

  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1E1E1E"/>

    <rect x="32" y="130" width="8" height="8" rx="3" fill="#EA4437">

    <rect x="331" y="471" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#EA4437"/>

    <rect x="356" y="551" width="14" height="4" rx="2" fill="#379D53"/>

  <g transform="translate(195 354)" opacity="0.9">

    </rect>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="719" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="19px" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Запускаем Яндекс</text>
